title: command history
rule: Keep a visible record of what was done, to what, and when, as the user performs actions.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Doing Things — Command History (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: A visible record shows what was done, to what, and when.
fail_when: No visible history of what / to what / when.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
